testcase.name: Project Selector Displays All Accessible Projects
testcase.summary: Verify that the project selector dropdown in the header displays all test projects the logged-in user has access to.
testcase.preconditions:
1. User is logged in as admin
  2. Admin has access to multiple test projects (P2, P3, TLU, TP)

step.actions: Observe the header area and locate the "Test Project" dropdown
step.expected_results: The dropdown is visible and contains "Test Project" label

step.actions: Click the project selector dropdown
step.expected_results: Dropdown opens showing all projects: P2:Project Two, P3:Project Three, TLU:TLU: TestLink Upgraded 2.0.1, TP:Test Project

step.actions: Verify each option has correct format: Prefix:Full Name
step.expected_results: All options follow the naming convention and display correctly

testcase.name: Current Project Is Pre-selected in Header
testcase.summary: Verify that the project currently active is pre-selected (highlighted) in the project selector dropdown.
testcase.preconditions:
1. User is logged in as admin
  2. Currently active project is TLU:TLU: TestLink Upgraded 2.0.1

step.actions: Observe the project selector dropdown in the header
step.expected_results: The dropdown shows "TLU:TLU: TestLink Upgraded 2.0.1" as the selected/visible value

step.actions: Open the dropdown and verify the selected attribute
step.expected_results: The TLU option has the "selected" state, matching the currently active test project

testcase.name: Switch Test Project Changes Context
testcase.summary: Verify that selecting a different project from the header dropdown reloads the application with the new project context.
testcase.preconditions:
1. User is logged in as admin
  2. Currently in TLU project
  3. Admin has access to P2:Project Two

step.actions: Note the current project name in the dropdown (TLU)
step.expected_results: TLU project is displayed

step.actions: Open the project selector dropdown and select "P2:Project Two"
step.expected_results: The application reloads

step.actions: After reload, check the project selector dropdown value
step.expected_results: "P2:Project Two" is now displayed as selected. The entire application context (tree, content) now shows P2 data.

testcase.name: Switch Project Preserves Feature Context
testcase.summary: Verify that when switching projects via the header dropdown, the application attempts to return to the same feature/page type in the new project (e.g., if on Test Specification, remain on Test Specification).
testcase.preconditions:
1. User is logged in as admin
  2. Currently in TLU project on Test Specification page
  3. Admin has access to TP:Test Project

step.actions: Navigate to Test Specification (editTc feature)
step.expected_results: Test Specification tree is displayed in the left panel

step.actions: Switch to TP:Test Project via the header dropdown
step.expected_results: Application reloads

step.actions: Check if the main content area shows Test Specification for TP project
step.expected_results: The page returns to Test Specification (or the closest equivalent) in the new project context, instead of the default dashboard

testcase.name: Logo Click Reloads Main View
testcase.summary: Verify that clicking the TestLink logo in the header navigates back to the main dashboard/index page for the current project.
testcase.preconditions:
1. User is logged in as admin
  2. Currently on any sub-page (e.g., Test Specification)

step.actions: Navigate away from the main dashboard to any sub-page (e.g., Test Specification, Event Viewer)
step.expected_results: Sub-page content is displayed in the main frame

step.actions: Click the TestLink logo in the top-left corner of the header
step.expected_results: The page navigates to index.php, showing the main dashboard for the current project

step.actions: Verify the URL contains the correct tproject_id parameter
step.expected_results: URL matches index.php?tproject_id=X where X is the current project ID

testcase.name: Logo Image Loads Without Broken Image
testcase.summary: Verify the TestLink logo image in the header loads correctly without any 404 or broken image icon.

step.actions: Inspect the header area visually
step.expected_results: The TestLink logo image (tl-logo-transparent-25.png) is fully visible and not broken

testcase.name: Header Displays Logged-In User Info
testcase.summary: Verify that the header displays the logged-in user's username and role in the format "username [role]".

step.actions: After login, observe the top-right area of the header
step.expected_results: Text "admin [admin]" is displayed as a clickable link

step.actions: Verify the element has a tooltip/title attribute
step.expected_results: The title attribute shows "admin [admin]"

testcase.name: User Info Link Opens Profile Page
testcase.summary: Verify that clicking the user info link in the header opens the user profile/info page within the main content frame.

step.actions: Click on "admin [admin]" link in the header
step.expected_results: The main content frame loads userInfo.php showing user profile details (login, role, email, etc.)

step.actions: Verify the URL contains tproject_id parameter
step.expected_results: URL is userInfo.php?tproject_id=X&tplan_id=0

testcase.name: Logout Terminates Session and Redirects
testcase.summary: Verify that clicking Logout terminates the user session and redirects to the login page.

step.actions: Click the "Logout" link in the header
step.expected_results: The session is terminated and the login page is displayed

step.actions: Try to navigate back to the application using browser back button
step.expected_results: User cannot access protected content; login page is shown instead

step.actions: Verify cookies/session are cleared
step.expected_results: Session cookie is expired or removed

testcase.name: Logout Link Uses Correct Target
testcase.summary: Verify the Logout link uses target="top" to break out of all iframes when logging out.

step.actions: Inspect the Logout link in the header HTML
step.expected_results: The Logout link has target="top" and href="logout.php?viewer="

testcase.name: Sidebar Toggle Collapses Navigation
testcase.summary: Verify that clicking the hamburger icon (fa-bars) in the header toggles the left sidebar navigation between collapsed and expanded states.
testcase.preconditions:
1. User is logged in
  2. Sidebar is initially visible/expanded

step.actions: Observe the left sidebar is visible with menu items
step.expected_results: Sidebar is expanded showing: System, Projects, Requirements Design, Test Case Design, Test Plan, Plugins

step.actions: Click the hamburger icon (fa-bars) in the header
step.expected_results: The sidebar collapses/hides, giving more space to the main content area

step.actions: Click the hamburger icon again
step.expected_results: The sidebar expands back to its original state showing all menu items

testcase.name: All Header Elements Present After Fresh Login
testcase.summary: Smoke test: Verify that all header elements are present and visible immediately after login.
testcase.preconditions:
1. User is on the login page
  2. Valid credentials available (admin/admin)

step.actions: Login with valid credentials (admin / admin)
step.expected_results: Login successful, main application loads

step.actions:
Verify the following header elements are present:

  • Hamburger toggle icon
  • TestLink logo
  • "Test Project" label
  • Project selector dropdown
  • User info link (admin [admin])
  • Logout link
step.expected_results: All 6 header elements are visible and functional in the header bar

testcase.name: CSRF Token Present in Project Switch Form
testcase.summary: Verify that the project switch form includes CSRF protection tokens to prevent cross-site request forgery.

step.actions: Inspect the HTML source of the header's project switch form
step.expected_results: Form contains hidden fields: CSRFName and CSRFToken with valid values
